documents.title: Emergency Department Record
documents.author: emergency medicine
documents.body:
EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT - PHYSICIAN RECORD
Arrival: 06/12/2026 19:20

CC: fever, sore throat.

HPI: 35-year-old man without a spleen (laparoscopic splenectomy July 2024 for hereditary spherocytosis) with two days of sore throat and fever, 101.5 F (38.6 C) on his home thermometer. Took his usual penicillin. Came in because his doctors told him fever without a spleen means the ED.

PMH: hereditary spherocytosis; asplenia after splenectomy.
PSH: splenectomy, 2024.
Meds: folic acid 1 mg PO daily; penicillin V potassium 250 mg PO BID.
Allergies: no known drug allergies.
FH: hereditary spherocytosis in father and paternal grandfather.
SH: high school math teacher. Never smoker. Drinks socially, 1-2 per month.

Triage vitals: T 39 C (102.2 F), BP 130/80, P 88, RR 16.

Exam: Alert, nontoxic. Posterior pharynx red, no exudate, tonsils not enlarged. No cervical lymphadenopathy. Lungs clear. Heart regular. Abdomen soft, nontender, healed port scars. No rash. Remainder normal.

Labs: WBC 12,000/uL, hemoglobin 13.2 g/dL, platelets 250,000/uL. Blood cultures x2 drawn before antibiotics, pending.

ED course: Febrile asplenic patient. Ceftriaxone 2 g IV given after cultures. On reassessment comfortable and drinking without difficulty. Discussed with patient; discharged with strict return precautions for rigors, confusion, rash, or worsening.

Impression: fever and sore throat in an asplenic patient.
Disposition: home. Continue penicillin prophylaxis. Follow up with PCP. ED will call with culture results.

Emergency medicine

documents.title: Went to the ER last night
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi Doc, just letting you know I had a fever of 101.5 and a bad sore throat so I went to the ER like you told me. They gave me an IV antibiotic and sent me home around midnight. Throat still hurts but the fever is gone this morning. They said they'd call about blood cultures.

documents.title: RE: Went to the ER last night
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Rodney, that was exactly the right call. Glad the fever broke. Keep up the penicillin, fluids and rest. If the fever comes back, or you get chills, a rash or feel confused, go straight back in. I'll watch for the culture results, and it's been a while since your last physical, so let's get you in this summer.

documents.title: ED blood culture final
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Final blood culture report from the ED visit of 06/12/2026, received by fax: two sets, no growth at 5 days. Scanned for PCP review.
